description: Analytics and tracking inventory for Metronaut 9.0.3 (com.antescofo.metronaut), recovered statically. Event names only; no payload values, keys or tokens.

trackers.name: AppsFlyer
trackers.evidence: Frameworks/AppsFlyerLib.framework (stub; code linked into main binary: 228 "appsflyer" string hits); Info.plist NSAdvertisingAttributionReportEndpoint https://appsflyer-skadnetwork.com/; NSPrivacyTrackingDomains att.*.appsflyersdk.com etc.; params appsflyer_id / af_web_id sent to Metronaut auth API
trackers.role: Install attribution, SKAdNetwork, deep links (OneLink: ".onelink.me" in Networking)

trackers.name: Branch
trackers.evidence: Resources/BranchSDK_BranchSDK.bundle; Info.plist branch_key {live,test} (values not reproduced) and branch_universal_link_domains; hosts api3.branch.io, api3-eu.branch.io, api-safetrack(-eu).branch.io, cdn.branch.io, bnc.lt

trackers.name: Braze
trackers.evidence: Frameworks/BrazeKit.framework, Resources/braze-swift-sdk_BrazeUI.bundle; 778 "braze" string hits; Metronaut.BrazeDataSource {lastReportedOpenedPieceId, lastReportedIsPremium}
trackers.role: CRM: push, in-app messages, content cards, banners, feature flags, geofences. 388 "crm.*" strings in en table are its copy

trackers.name: Facebook SDK (Core, Login, AEM)
trackers.evidence: Frameworks/FBSDKCoreKit, FBSDKCoreKit_Basics, FBSDKLoginKit, FBAEMKit; Info.plist FacebookAutoLogAppEventsEnabled = true, FacebookAdvertiserIDCollectionEnabled = true, FacebookAppID present (value not reproduced)
trackers.role: Login + automatic app-event logging + Aggregated Event Measurement (ad attribution)

trackers.name: Firebase / Google Analytics for Firebase
trackers.evidence: Frameworks/FirebaseAnalytics, GoogleAppMeasurement, GoogleAppMeasurementIdentitySupport; bundles Firebase_FirebaseABTesting, FirebaseCore, FirebaseCrashlytics, FirebaseInstallations; strings firebaseremoteconfig.googleapis.com, app-analytics-services.com; GoogleService-Info.plist present (keys not reproduced); Info.plist FirebaseAppDelegateProxyEnabled = false
trackers.role: Analytics, Remote Config, A/B testing, Installations, App Check endpoint referenced

trackers.name: Amplitude
trackers.evidence: Resources/Amplitude_Amplitude.bundle; hosts api2.amplitude.com, api.eu.amplitude.com, regionconfig(.eu).amplitude.com; Swift types AnalyticsConnector.*; header names ampDeviceId / ampSessionId in Networking (sent to Metronaut backend)
trackers.role: Product analytics (likely primary event sink for the in-house Analytics package)

trackers.name: Apple AdServices / SKAdNetwork
trackers.evidence: https://api-adservices.apple.com/api/v1/ in main binary; 82 "skadnetwork" string hits; NSUserTrackingUsageDescription (ATT prompt)
trackers.role: Apple Search Ads attribution, SKAN postbacks

trackers.name: Google Sign-In
trackers.evidence: GoogleSignIn bundles; GIDClientID in Info.plist (value not reproduced)
trackers.role: Login (not a tracker, but a Google data flow)
